title: The Hacker Heist
story: In the world-renowned tech startup, 'CyberByte Solutions', a mysterious series of events led to the abrupt theft of their most valuable intellectual property - a groundbreaking artificial intelligence algorithm. The CEO, Thomas Lukas, has fallen prey to a cunning cybercrime, and the clock is ticking as the culprit remains elusive.
victim: Thomas Lukas, CEO of CyberByte Solutions
crimeScene: CyberByte Solutions HQ - a futuristic digital fortress with cutting-edge security systems
forensicClue: A discrepancy in the AI algorithm's coding history (modified at 23:47 on the night of the theft)
question: Who is responsible for the AI algorithm theft and how was the crime committed?
options: Option A: Kira, the AI developer and motive: jealousy due to John's promotion; time of theft: matches her last login; reason: Her expertise and access
Option B: John, the AI architect and motive: financial gain; time of theft: matches his login; reason: Insider knowledge
Option C: Maria, the cybersecurity specialist and motive: revenge; time of theft: pre-dates all logins; reason: Abnormal network traffic
Option D: Nicholas, the data analyst and motive: corporate espionage; time of theft: post-dates all logins; reason: Anomalous data export
